now.title: VisionQuest
now.text: In episode 2, living in Edinburgh, Vision is hunted by the bounty hunter Paladin and rescues Tommy, who claims to be his son.

changes.evidence: The record describes Vision living in Edinburgh (he works at The Old Selkie pub in Edinburgh, where Paladin's men attack him) and rescuing Tommy, which happens at Saint Mabyn's Psychiatric Sanitarium in London. Both are clearly located, yet the record shows no place.

now.title: VisionQuest
now.text: In episode 6, after lowering his firewall to retake his body, which lets Ultron escape, Vision reaches Madripoor with Lisa, fights off the Ten Rings with Tommy's help, and flees with him.

changes.evidence: The record says Vision reaches Madripoor with Lisa and fights the Ten Rings there; White Vision's page: 'arrived in Madripoor with Lisa Molinari. They confronted Paladin and combated the Ten Rings'. Madripoor is an app place, but none is shown.

now.title: Hawkeye
now.text: With Laura's help, Clint secretly takes his sword back.

proposed.text: At the Bishops' penthouse, Clint quietly takes his sword back from Jack Duquesne.

changes.evidence: Laura plays no part in it. In Hawkeye episode 4, Clint keeps an eye on the sword at the Bishop Residence while talking to Eleanor, then quietly takes it and hides it under his jacket as he leaves.

now.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
now.text: Wakanda's people shelter in the Jabari mountains after Namor's attack, and M'Baku fights beside Shuri.
cases: ST-104 The Battle on the Atlantic (Black Panther: Wakanda Forever)

changes.evidence: The record's fight beside Shuri is the battle aboard the Sea Leopard at sea (the case shown is ST-104 The Battle on the Atlantic); M'Baku's own record already shows The Atlantic Ocean. Only Wakanda is shown here.

now.title: Avengers: Endgame
now.text: Ramonda welcomes T'Challa home after the Blip is undone.

changes.evidence: In Avengers: Endgame Ramonda reunites with T'Challa and Shuri at the Citadel in Birnin Zana, Wakanda, and watches the celebration in the city. The record shows no place.
